messages.subject: TokyoR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Ms. Sekiya,

Thank you so much for responding to my query. I have two main interests in contacting you.

My primary motivation is to help support R user groups in Japan. As the administrator of the R Consortium's R User Group Support Program <https://www.r-consortium.org/projects/r-user-group-support-program>, I would like to encourage existing R user groups to apply for support if the organizers think that the small financial grants we can offer, and association with our meetup.com Pro Account <https://www.meetup.com/pro/r-user-groups/> would help them grow and nurture their groups. I would also like to encourage the formation of new R user groups.

My second motivation is to help spread the word about the mission of the R Consortium <https://www.r-consortium.org/> to support the R Community by promoting the R Language in business and industry, and financing projects <https://www.r-consortium.org/projects> that provide benefits to significant numbers of R users.

I will be attending the useR! 2018 Conference <https://user2018.r-project.org/> in Australia this summer and I am considering visiting Japan as part of that trip.

Best regards,

Joseph

Joseph B. Rickert
RStudio R Community Ambassador
R Consortium Director
San Jose, CA
Cell: 408.489.0566
